ops.title: Developer console · Plattr
ops.heading: Developer console
ops.prototype_line: NudgeBee is simulated in this prototype. The alert rules and the workflow files are the real ones from deploy/ and nudgebee/.
ops.audience: For the team that builds and runs Plattr, not for sellers or buyers. It shows what Flagsmith, NudgeBee and Sarvam do on this server.

flagsmith.connected: Connected to Flagsmith (environment key set). The server evaluates the flags and sends the results to the pages.
flagsmith.defaults: Flag defaults in code: FLAGSMITH_ENVIRONMENT_KEY is not set
flagsmith.changes_flagsmith: Approve on the NudgeBee tab changes ops_reading for lang_kn in Flagsmith, through the management API.
flagsmith.changes_memory: Approve on the NudgeBee tab changes ops_reading for lang_kn in the memory of this server, because the organisation key or the rollback ids are not set.
flagsmith.flags_lead: The value that this server reads now, from flags.environment(), and the default in code of each flag.
flagsmith.segments_lead: For one preview order of each language, from flags.forOrder with its language trait and the in-memory overrides. Reading these decisions records no experiment exposure.
flagsmith.overrides_lead: The simulation on the NudgeBee tab sets these on top of the flags. A restart removes them.
flagsmith.overrides_none: None. The flags apply as they are.
flagsmith.question: Question
flagsmith.question_text: Does native reading need fewer corrections than translate-first reading?
flagsmith.outside: Conversions of orders outside the experiment: {count}.
flagsmith.experiment_note: Counted by this server since it started. Flagsmith shows the results of the experiment, with their statistics.

nudgebee.files_lead: The simulation follows these real files. This server does not load them.
nudgebee.rules_note: Only the critical alert starts a NudgeBee investigation.
nudgebee.flag_change_events: Each Flagsmith flag change becomes a NudgeBee event.
nudgebee.rollback_lang_kn: After approval, ops_reading is safe for lang_kn only.

sarvam.live: Live: each call goes to Sarvam and uses credit.
sarvam.recorded: Recorded: saved answers replay, and no call goes to Sarvam.
sarvam.saved: {saved} saved answers: {placeholders} of them are placeholders, and {test_only} are for tests only.
sarvam.calls_lead: From sarvam_requests_total in the metrics of this server, by API and model.
sarvam.no_calls: No Sarvam call since the server started.
sarvam.billed_heading: Billed units since the server started
sarvam.billed_lead: From sarvam_billed_units_total. Only 2xx answers in live mode count.
sarvam.no_billed: No billed units since the server started.

readings.heading: Readings in the last 2 minutes
readings.lead: From the metrics of this server (reading_results_total), by language. The table updates every 2 seconds.
readings.rule: The alert would fire when more than 30% of 5 or more readings of one language are invalid in 2 minutes. In the cluster, Prometheus fires it when this holds for 2 minutes.
readings.pending: Would fire · over the limit for {held} of the 2:00 it needs

run.heading: NudgeBee run
run.watching: Waiting for an alert. A critical alert starts the investigation.
run.alert: ReadingInvalidRateHigh would fire for Kannada (kn-IN). The simulation starts the investigation at once; in the cluster, NudgeBee starts it when the alert fires.
run.investigation: Likely cause: a change of cfg_sarvam for the segment lang_kn. It turned reasoning on with 256 maximum tokens, so the Kannada answers come back cut off (finish_reason: length) and the readings are invalid. Hindi and English did not change.
run.fix: Fix: switch ops_reading to safe for lang_kn only. Other languages do not change.
run.approval: Approve to switch only Kannada to the safe reading path: ops_reading gets the value safe for the segment lang_kn. Reject to change nothing.
run.approved_flagsmith: Approved. Flagsmith answered 200: ops_reading is safe for the segment lang_kn.
run.approved_memory: Approved. ops_reading is safe for the segment lang_kn, in the memory of this server, because this server has no Flagsmith project to change.
run.rejected: Rejected. Nothing changed: ops_reading for lang_kn stays as it was.
run.recovery_wait: No Kannada reading since the change yet. Send a Kannada order.
run.recovered: Kannada readings recovered: no invalid reading since the change.
run.next: Next, by hand: remove the bad cfg_sarvam override for lang_kn, then set ops_reading for lang_kn back to ai.

controls.heading: Demo controls
controls.memory: This server has no Flagsmith project, so these controls change the flag defaults in its memory. A restart removes them.
controls.flagsmith: This server reads its flags from Flagsmith. Add the cfg_sarvam override for lang_kn in Flagsmith: reasoning on, 256 maximum tokens.
controls.trigger: Set the bad cfg_sarvam for lang_kn
controls.trigger_done: The bad cfg_sarvam is set for lang_kn: reasoning on, 256 maximum tokens. Send Kannada orders, and the readings fail.
controls.reset_done: Both overrides are removed. Kannada uses the default flags again.

error.forbidden: This server reads its flags from Flagsmith. Add the cfg_sarvam override for lang_kn in Flagsmith instead.
error.invalid_input: No Kannada alert waits for approval now. Watch the readings, then approve when the alert would fire.
error.unavailable: Flagsmith or the server did not take the change, so nothing changed. Try again, or set ops_reading to safe for lang_kn by hand in Flagsmith.
